delivery.title: Detay livrezon - {{id}}
delivery.passExplainer: Enn "Pass" isi vedir zis ki server sib-la finn retourn enn stati HTTP 2xx - sa pa konfirme ki sistem resever-la finn vremem stok ouswa finn tret lead-la. Verifie lekor repons lao pou kone ki li finn vremem dir; si li vid ou zis enn rekonesans, sa sistem-la kapav pe resevwar demann-la me pe rezet ou pe inyor payload-la intern (bann move nom/format domenn pou so API , enn domenn obligatwar lor so kote ki sa payload-la pa inklir, etc).

push.title: Webhooks Sorti - Bann Push Leads & Updates
push.intro: Konpletman personalizab par webhook : JSON , Form (x-www-form-urlencoded), ou ou prop Custom body template avek bann placeholder <fieldkey></fieldkey> (ex <example></example> ) - mars kouma ranpli enn komann cURL enn fwa.
push.curlHelp: Kol lexanp demann ki zot bann dokiman API ouswa Postman donn ou (avek bann done reel ouswa lexanp). URL , metod ek bann header finn kopie kouma zot ete, ek sak lakle dan lekor finn liste anba pou ki ou kapav swazir ki domenn CRM pou ranpli li pou sak lead.

receive.title: Resevwar - Aksepte bann lead dan ninport ki format
receive.intro: Sak sours gagn so prop URL . Montre bann piblisite pou bann lead Facebook , Zapier , enn form sitweb ouswa enn lot webhook CRM - zot avoy bann lead dan zot prop format JSON ouswa form, ek ou map zot bann domenn avek ou.

pull.title: Pull - Fetch bann leads depi ninport ki API
pull.intro: Leadrat apel API enn lot sistem lor enn program (ninport ki auth, ninport ki paz) e inport bann rezis ki li retourne. Bann rikord ki li finn trouve avan met mem lead azour.

api.title: Ou API - Akse de-fason pou ninport ki sistem
api.intro: Ninport ki sistem avek ou lakle API kapav kree, lir ek met azour bann lead e abone a bann evennman lead. Avoy lakle dan <hdr></hdr> header, kouma <bearer></bearer> , ou (si zouti-la pa kapav met bann header) kouma <query></query> . Limit: {{limit}} demann par minit.
api.noPermission: Zis enn dimounn ki ena permision Zer bann Paramet ki kapav get lakle API .
api.shownOnce: Kopie sa lakle-la aster-la ek stor li enn plas an sekirite - pou sekirite li montre zis enn fwa. Si li finn perdi, zener enn nouvo.
api.regenerateConfirm: Zener enn nouvo lakle API ? Lakle aktyel aret fonksione toutswit pou sak sistem ki pe servi li.
api.openApiHint: Inport spesifikasion OpenAPI dan Postman , Zapier , Make ou n8n pou ki sak endpoint pare pou servi.
